attribution: Contains data from Wikidata, licensed under the CC0 1.0 public domain dedication; filtered and transformed by Mundus.
transformations: Stream the complete pinned Wikidata -all- dump offline and reject compressed-source identity drift
Keep item records with a valid Earth P625 coordinate, an English or Chinese label, and a deterministic non-deprecated P571 or P580 start statement
Keep interpretable time precision 6 through 11 and reference years before 1500 without converting coarse dates into finer precision
Classify P31 values through the current four-root transitive P279 closure, ignoring deprecated P279 statements and applying the reviewed denylist barriers
Select preferred-rank values before normal-rank values and use stable statement identities for deterministic ties
Sort records by numeric Wikidata QID and retain source provenance for type, start, coordinate, and label selection
missingValuePolicy: Records without a valid Earth coordinate, an English or Chinese label, a qualifying type, or an interpretable pre-1500 start statement are excluded; missing values are never imputed.
boundaryPolicy: A fixed 150 km observation around a selected point reports snapshot record coverage. The artifact is not a complete historical gazetteer, a list of nearby attractions, or a claim about the amount or continuity of local history.
